predeclared_selector_registry.principle: Stationarity/minimum of the existing nonnegative placement energy at fixed admissible m.
predeclared_selector_registry.success_condition: A unique localized m modulo explicitly stated lattice symmetries follows without a preparation.

predeclared_selector_registry.principle: Nonnegative second variation in u and continuation within existing admissible m/mu.
predeclared_selector_registry.success_condition: A stability/continuation result distinguishes one localized pattern or one history class without scheduling.

predeclared_selector_registry.principle: The already represented N_m=1 constraint only.
predeclared_selector_registry.success_condition: The existing invariant uniquely selects a localized configuration rather than only a class.

predeclared_selector_registry.principle: Existing fixed-dt mechanical discrete action, varied only in u at fixed admissible m/mu, where defined.
predeclared_selector_registry.success_condition: Stationarity selects one oriented history without a mu evolution law or endpoint preparation.

predeclared_selector_registry.principle: Boundary conditions, preload, source-off preparation, finite domain, refinement, and replay records.
predeclared_selector_registry.success_condition: A control is not counted as a selector; it may only expose dependence or covariance.

selection_distinctions.history_class: Permission for a class of admissible mu(t) histories.
selection_distinctions.oriented_history: Dynamic selection of one time-oriented member of a permitted history class.
selection_distinctions.static_pattern: Selection of one static m configuration.
